title.narrative: Technical assistance to develop the capacity of the government on immigration and border management in Sudan. 2020-2023.

description.narrative: The objective of this project is to enhance Sudan’s technical capacity to manage migration by improving border management procedures and processes.

tag.narrative: Facilitate orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility of people, including through the implementation of planned and well-managed migration policies
